# Append-only guarantees enforced outside ORM

The code documents that delta tables are append-only and that enforcement is provided by grants in the migration (external SQL). The ORM schema itself does not enforce append-only semantics, so missing or incorrect migrations or grant application could allow mutations that violate the intended immutability.
